26 * here.

28typedef struct
29{
30 uint32_t codepoint; /* Unicode codepoint */
31 uint8_t comb_class; /* combining class of character */
32 uint8_t dec_size_flags; /* size and flags of decomposition code list */
33 uint16_t dec_index; /* index into UnicodeDecomp_codepoints, or the
34 * decomposition itself if DECOMP_INLINE */
35} pg_unicode_decomposition;
36
37#define DECOMP_NO_COMPOSE 0x80 // don't use for re-composition
38#define DECOMP_INLINE 0x40 // decomposition is stored inline in dec_index
39#define DECOMP_COMPAT 0x20 // compatibility mapping
40
41#define DECOMPOSITION_SIZE(x) ((x)->dec_size_flags & 0x1F)
42#define DECOMPOSITION_NO_COMPOSE(x) (((x)->dec_size_flags & (DECOMP_NO_COMPOSE | DECOMP_COMPAT)) != 0)
43#define DECOMPOSITION_IS_INLINE(x) (((x)->dec_size_flags & DECOMP_INLINE) != 0)
44#define DECOMPOSITION_IS_COMPAT(x) (((x)->dec_size_flags & DECOMP_COMPAT) != 0)
